# Tab-separated lines, replayed in order on one session (built-in keymap
# and rules, data/SKK-JISYO.S):
#   new                          start a fresh session
#   keys  <keys>  <state>        press the keys, then nablaskk_take_state
#   rules <text>  <result>       nablaskk_set_user_rules (\n = newline)
# Keys: printable ASCII as is (capitals and shifted symbols carry shift),
# <SPC> <RET> <ESC> <BS> <TAB> <DEL> <LEFT> <RIGHT> <UP> <DOWN> <lt>, and
# <C-x> for Ctrl+x. The state and result must match byte for byte.

# Direct input
keys	a	{"fixed":"あ","composing":"","cursor":0,"mode":"hirakana","candidates":{"visible":false,"items":[],"cursor":0,"page":0,"pageCount":0},"annotation":null}
keys	k	{"fixed":"","composing":"k","cursor":0,"mode":"hirakana","candidates":{"visible":false,"items":[],"cursor":0,"page":0,"pageCount":0},"annotation":null}
keys	a	{"fixed":"か","composing":"","cursor":0,"mode":"hirakana","candidates":{"visible":false,"items":[],"cursor":0,"page":0,"pageCount":0},"annotation":null}
keys	tt	{"fixed":"っ","composing":"t","cursor":0,"mode":"hirakana","candidates":{"visible":false,"items":[],"cursor":0,"page":0,"pageCount":0},"annotation":null}
keys	<C-g>	{"fixed":"","composing":"","cursor":0,"mode":"hirakana","candidates":{"visible":false,"items":[],"cursor":0,"page":0,"pageCount":0},"annotation":null}

# User rules
rules	fj,、,、,､	[{"line":1,"input":"fj","applied":true,"reason":null}]
keys	fj	{"fixed":"、","composing":"","cursor":0,"mode":"hirakana","candidates":{"visible":false,"items":[],"cursor":0,"page":0,"pageCount":0},"annotation":null}
rules	ka.,…,…,…	[{"line":1,"input":"ka.","applied":false,"reason":"「ka → か」がすぐに確定しなくなるため使えません"}]
keys	ka	{"fixed":"か","composing":"","cursor":0,"mode":"hirakana","candidates":{"visible":false,"items":[],"cursor":0,"page":0,"pageCount":0},"annotation":null}
keys	<C-g>	{"fixed":"","composing":"","cursor":0,"mode":"hirakana","candidates":{"visible":false,"items":[],"cursor":0,"page":0,"pageCount":0},"annotation":null}
rules	# comment\n\nfj,、,、,､\nlj,x,x,x\nfj,。,。,｡	[{"line":3,"input":"fj","applied":true,"reason":null},{"line":4,"input":"lj","applied":false,"reason":"l は英数モードへの切替キーなので、このルールは入力できません"},{"line":5,"input":"fj","applied":false,"reason":"追加したルール「fj → 、」と入力キーが衝突します"}]
